title: goodenia glabrata
intro: Goodenia glabrata, commonly known as Rough Goodenia or Goodenia, is a plant species belonging to the family Goodeniaceae. This Australian native plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including providing relief for colds, coughs, and respiratory issues due to its potential health benefits in reducing inflammation and promoting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Goodenia glabrata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in soothing sore throats and combating infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
